segments.ja508:1.1: Pañca paṇḍitā samāgatāttha, pañhā me paṭibhāti taṃ suṇātha;
segments.ja508:1.3: Nindiyamatthaṃ pasaṃsiyaṃ vā, kassevāvikareyya [kassa vāvīkareyya (ka.)] guyhamatthaṃ.
segments.ja508:2.1: Tvaṃ āvikarohi bhūmipāla, bhattā bhārasaho tuvaṃ vade taṃ;
segments.ja508:2.3: Tava chandarucīni [chandañca ruciñca (sī. pī.)] sammasitvā, atha vakkhanti janinda pañca dhīrā.
segments.ja508:3.1: Yā sīlavatī anaññatheyyā [anaññadheyyā (sī. pī.)], bhattucchandavasānugā (piyā)[() natthi sī. pī. potthakesu] manāpā;
segments.ja508:3.3: Nindiyamatthaṃ pasaṃsiyaṃ vā, bhariyāyāvikareyya [bhariyāya vāvīkareyya (ka.)] guyhamatthaṃ.
segments.ja508:4.1: Yo kicchagatassa āturassa, saraṇaṃ hoti gatī parāyanañca;
segments.ja508:4.3: Nindiyamatthaṃ pasaṃsiyaṃ vā, sakhino vāvikareyya guyhamatthaṃ.
segments.ja508:5.1: Jeṭṭho [yo jeṭṭho (syā.)] atha majjhimo kaniṭṭho, yo [so (sī. syā. pī.)] ce sīlasamāhito ṭhitatto;
segments.ja508:5.3: Nindiyamatthaṃ pasaṃsiyaṃ vā, bhātu vāvīkareyya guyhamatthaṃ.
segments.ja508:6.1: Yo ve pituhadayassa paddhagū [patthagū (syā.), pattagū (ka.)], anujāto pitaraṃ anomapañño;
segments.ja508:6.3: Nindiyamatthaṃ pasaṃsiyaṃ vā, puttassāvikareyya [puttassa vāvīkareyya (ka.)] guyhamatthaṃ.
segments.ja508:7.1: Mātā dvipadājanindaseṭṭha, yā naṃ [yo taṃ (sī. pī.)] poseti chandasā piyena;
segments.ja508:7.3: Nindiyamatthaṃ pasaṃsiyaṃ vā, mātuyāvīkareyya [mātuyā vāvīkareyya (ka.)] guyhamatthaṃ.
segments.ja508:8.1: Guyhassa hi guyhameva sādhu, na hi guyhassa pasatthamāvikammaṃ;
segments.ja508:8.3: Anipphannatā [anipphādāya (sī. pī.), anipphannatāya (syā.), ā nipphādā (?)] saheyya dhīro, nipphannova [nipphannattho (sī. pī.), nipphannatthova (syā.)] yathāsukhaṃ bhaṇeyya.
segments.ja508:9.1: Kiṃ tvaṃ vimanosi rājaseṭṭha, dvipadajaninda [dipadinda (sī. syā. pī.)] vacanaṃ suṇoma metaṃ [netaṃ (sī. pī.), tetaṃ (syā.)];
segments.ja508:9.3: Kiṃ cintayamāno dummanosi, nūna deva aparādho atthi mayhaṃ.
segments.ja508:10.1: “Paṇhe [pañño (sī. pī.), pañhe (syā.), panhe (ka.)] vajjho mahosadho”ti, āṇatto me vadhāya bhūripañño;
segments.ja508:10.3: Taṃ cintayamāno dummanosmi, na hi devī aparādho atthi tuyhaṃ.
segments.ja508:11.1: Abhidosagato dāni ehisi, kiṃ sutvā kiṃ saṅkate mano te;
segments.ja508:11.3: Ko te kimavoca bhūripañña, iṅgha vacanaṃ suṇoma brūhi metaṃ.
segments.ja508:12.1: “Paṇhe vajjho mahosadho”ti, yadi te mantayitaṃ janinda dosaṃ;
segments.ja508:12.3: Bhariyāya rahogato asaṃsi, guyhaṃ pātukataṃ sutaṃ mametaṃ.
segments.ja508:13.1: Yaṃ sālavanasmiṃ senako, pāpakammaṃ akāsi asabbhirūpaṃ;
segments.ja508:13.3: Sakhinova rahogato asaṃsi, guyhaṃ pātukataṃ sutaṃ mametaṃ.
segments.ja508:14.1: Pukkusa [pakkusa (ka.) jā.1.7.41 paṇṇajātake passitabbaṃ] purisassa te janinda, uppanno rogo arājayutto;
segments.ja508:14.3: Bhātuñca [bhātucca (sī. pī.), bhātuva (syā.)] rahogato asaṃsi, guyhaṃ pātukataṃ sutaṃ mametaṃ.
segments.ja508:15.1: Ābādhoyaṃ asabbhirūpo, kāmindo [kāvindo (sī. pī.)] naradevena phuṭṭho;
segments.ja508:15.3: Puttassa rahogato asaṃsi, guyhaṃ pātukataṃ sutaṃ mametaṃ.
segments.ja508:16.1: Aṭṭhavaṅkaṃ maṇiratanaṃ uḷāraṃ, sakko te adadā pitāmahassa;
segments.ja508:16.3: Devindassa gataṃ tadajja hatthaṃ [devindassa tadajja hatthagataṃ (ka.)], mātuñca rahogato asaṃsi;
segments.ja508:17.1: Guyhassa hi guyhameva sādhu, na hi guyhassa pasatthamāvikammaṃ;
segments.ja508:17.3: Anipphannatā saheyya dhīro, nipphannova yathāsukhaṃ bhaṇeyya.
segments.ja508:18.1: Na guyhamatthaṃ vivareyya, rakkheyya naṃ yathā nidhiṃ;
segments.ja508:18.3: Na hi pātukato sādhu, guyho attho pajānatā.
segments.ja508:19.1: Thiyā guyhaṃ na saṃseyya, amittassa ca paṇḍito;
segments.ja508:19.3: Yo cāmisena saṃhīro, hadayattheno ca yo naro.
segments.ja508:21.3: Tāvanto tassa ubbegā, tasmā guyhaṃ na vissaje.
segments.ja508:22.1: Vivicca bhāseyya divā rahassaṃ, rattiṃ giraṃ nātivelaṃ pamuñce;
segments.ja508:22.3: Upassutikā hi suṇanti mantaṃ, tasmā manto khippamupeti bhedanti.
